limitations: MariaDB is included and has real-server local contracts; exact Preview 2 native MariaDB acceptance remains pending.
Listed checks are workflow slices, not comprehensive acceptance of every supported driver feature.
Native MySQL/MariaDB TLS, NoSQL TLS/mTLS/SSH, broader edit/import/diagram paths and other unchecked transports remain pending.
Windows, Linux, Intel Macs, other macOS versions, Developer ID signing and notarization remain pending.
PostgreSQL planner/storage statistics added after this source commit are available only in newer source builds.
Source debug-app screenshot tour is not a continuous recording or proof of this release artifact.
privacy: Receipt hashes are retained for attribution. Raw accessibility trees, private fixture profiles, database passwords, Keychain state and user workspace files are excluded.
